## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Cog runtime changes include a higher `info.json` version
- [ ] Commands, setup, permissions, dependencies, and behavior are documented
- [ ] New dependencies are declared in `info.json`, `pyproject.toml`, and the cog README
- [ ] Stored user data, privileged intents, credentials, and external-service impacts are disclosed
- [ ] No tokens, credentials, production data, or unrelated generated files are included
- [ ] The change is focused enough to review safely
